subject.title: fix(ollama): remote Ollama streaming stalls at model_call:started on slow hosts

question: Should native Ollama streams treat `timeoutSeconds` as an idle/progress timeout while chunks arrive, matching sibling guarded streaming transports, once real remote-Ollama proof is added?
rationale: The code change is narrow, but it intentionally changes existing timeout semantics for a provider stream, and that compatibility choice should be maintainer-owned rather than inferred from green tests.

options.title: Accept after proof
options.body: Require redacted real remote/slow Ollama proof, then accept idle-timeout parity with the other guarded streaming transports.

options.title: Keep hard timeout
options.body: Do not merge this branch unless it preserves a separate wall-clock cap or documents a maintainer-approved replacement contract.

options.title: Pause for another design
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers want a broader provider timeout design instead of an Ollama-local stream-loop fix.

recommendation.title: Accept after proof
recommendation.body: Require redacted real remote/slow Ollama proof, then accept idle-timeout parity with the other guarded streaming transports.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Ollama stream/runtime ownership makes this the strongest routing candidate for the provider-specific timeout decision.
